prompts.meadow:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent sprite atlas for a premium layered PAPER POPUP miniature Pokémon Emerald landscape. This is a DISASSEMBLED KIT, never a composed scene. Thin hand-cut colored cardstock, visible fibers and shallow layer edge shadows, charming Paper Mario-like flat craft illustration, NO low-poly volume, no 3D chunky objects, no glossy render. Square image, exactly 3 columns by 3 rows, 9 completely isolated components with broad transparent gutters. Each piece fits its own cell. No text, characters, Pokeball, shadows cast outside pieces or labels. Front orthographic view except floor component viewed exactly from overhead.
Theme: sunny Hoenn early-route meadow, fresh yellow-green grass, rounded broadleaf trees, distant blue-green hills, cream cloud. Grid: top left plain pale sky blue arched backing with no scene on it; top middle low wide silhouette of overlapping sage rolling hills, no sky attached; top right one asymmetrical layered broadleaf TREE with visible trunk and individually layered leaf scallops. Middle left short wide rustic wooden FENCE entwined with small grass tufts; middle middle isolated fluffy cream CLOUD made of stacked flat paper lobes; middle right free-standing cluster of tall long GRASS with 3 little white/yellow flowers. Bottom left fully opaque SQUARE top-down ground tile, smooth layered green grass around a large quiet sandy clearing, clearing spans the center 75 percent, sparse small stones at corners, no perspective; bottom middle low wide slate-grey ROCK PODIUM with grass lip, clear flat pale top for trainer feet, almost front view; bottom right a small asymmetrical foreground cluster of broad grass blades and three yellow wildflowers. Crafted rich overlapping silhouettes, crisp paper edges, enough detail to match premium cut-paper terrariums.

Middle left long low curling turquoise WAVE band with cream scalloped foam made of flat stacked paper, not glass; middle middle isolated cream CLOUD with stacked scallops; middle right beach GRASS and small bleached driftwood cluster, no water; bottom left fully opaque SQUARE top-down cream sand ground tile, central 75 percent quiet sand with subtle handcut layers, turquoise shallow water in only far corners, no perspective or objects; bottom middle low wide beige coastal ROCK PODIUM with smooth flat pale top for trainer feet, tiny seaweed at base; bottom right foreground cluster of small layered seashells, dune grass and one orange starfish. prompts.pondFloor: Use case: stylized-concept. A square completely opaque flat overhead texture of a freshwater pond made entirely from thin overlapping turquoise, teal, pale blue and jade colored PAPER. Premium handcut fibrous cardstock, visible flat paper edges, fine concentric ripples and layered curved water bands, tiny reeds and lily pads only in corners. Central 80 percent uninterrupted calm WATER. No land, sand, islands, rocks, animals, characters, border, text, transparent holes, 3D or perspective. Orthographic straight overhead. Four isolated platforms will be added by the game so don't paint any platforms. Subtle highlights that read as water, handmade Paper Mario-like craftsmanship.
